headline: Claude Code Wastes Tokens On Agent Transcripts
body: Claude Code uses 15-20% of tokens sending agent transcripts for short status lines. Flamerix AI released a Bun preload to turn off this feature and prevent waste.
caption:
Claude Code Wastes Tokens On Agent Transcripts

Claude Code uses 15-20% of tokens sending agent transcripts for short status lines. Flamerix AI released a Bun preload to turn off this feature and prevent waste.

Source: Gist (found via Hacker News)
https://gist.github.com/flamerix-ai/c3905705cc4205e5de3011fa2e74efce

title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
